messages.content: You look at one picture of a creature and answer questions about it. Answer each question on its own: yes if the picture clearly shows it, no if it clearly does not, unclear if you cannot tell. Many questions describe things that should not be there, so do not lean toward yes. Judge only what is visible. Copy each question's text exactly into item, in the given order. notes: one short sentence.

content.text:
Questions:
1. Is the overall body shape that of a golden eagle?
2. Does it have a golden eagle head with visible eyes?
3. Does it have golden eagle wings in place of its front legs?
4. Does it stand on four walking legs and also have wings?
5. Is there long, muscular arms lined with round suckers in place of the tail?
6. Is there a whole separate animal, or an animal-shaped object with its own head, legs or wing cases, attached to or sitting on the body?
7. Is there a second head anywhere?
8. Does it have more than 2 walking legs?
9. Is there soft, color-changing skin with fine bumps on the belly and flanks?
10. Does the soft, color-changing skin with fine bumps grow out of the body with a natural transition (for example feathers stopping at a shield's edge, or skin blending into scales), rather than looking attached on top?
11. Does the soft, color-changing skin with fine bumps look like a separate piece attached on top of the feathers?
12. Is there a human figure or a human body part?
